import re
def preprocess(row):
    # Remove underscores and dashes
    cleaned_name = re.sub(r'[_-]', '', row['name'])

    # Split the name by comma or double quotes, if present
    names = [name.strip() for name in re.split(r'\s*,\s*|"\s*|\s*"', cleaned_name)]

    # Remove empty strings and duplicates from the list
    unique_names = list(set(filter(None, names)))

    return {'name': ','.join(unique_names)}
